card.name: Start of the word smoking
card.fires_on: The first piece of the word smoking (SM, Sm, sm, m in nonsmoking) when it is split so that "oking" comes next. Seen in smoking cessation headings and cigarette smoking warnings.

modes.label: Smoking cessation

modes.description: The SM piece in the capitalized boxed warning about cigarette smoking and cardiovascular events.

modes.label: Nonsmoking patients
modes.description: The m piece inside nonsmoking in a patient description.

card.writes: It lowers the odds of smoking-related words coming next and slightly raises kit words.
card.plain: It spots the first piece of the word smoking just before the rest of the word is spelled out.
